```{python}
#| include: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import charts
from charts import raw_html

FEATURED_CLUB = "STL"  # club the explorer opens on
```

Attention here is Wikipedia pageviews: how many people looked a club up on a given
day. It is a proxy for **public attention**, not sponsor value. A club's *lift* on
a match day compares that day's views with the average of the 28 days before it.

## A club's year in attention

```{python}
#| output: asis
explorer = charts.club_explorer(FEATURED_CLUB)
if explorer is None:
    print("No pageview data loaded yet.")
else:
    chart, select = explorer
    html = charts.card(chart, "club-explorer")
    # Put the club picker between the subtitle and the chart.
    print(raw_html(html.replace("</figcaption>", "</figcaption>" + select, 1)))
```

## Which clubs get the biggest match-day bump?

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.card(charts.club_match_lift(), "match-lift", "No match data loaded yet.")))
```

## Does winning matter?

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.card(charts.lift_by_result(), "result-lift", "No match data loaded yet.")))
```

## Do sponsors get noticed on match day?

If fans look up a club on match day, do they also look up the brands on its kit
and stadium? This is the question a partnerships team would ask first, and the
obvious way to answer it is wrong.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.card(charts.weekend_effect(), "weekend", "No match data loaded yet.")))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html('''<div class="method-callout"><strong>The fix:</strong> compare each match day
with the same brand's non-match days <em>on the same weekday</em>, during the
deal only. A brand that held the sleeve from July counts only on match days from
July. Then test whether more match days land above that norm than chance would
give, adjusting for testing every brand at once.</div>'''))
print(raw_html(charts.card(charts.sponsor_match_day(), "sponsor-attention",
                           "Not enough sponsor pageview data yet.")))
```

## Which clubs are gaining attention?

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.card(charts.attention_by_season(), "season-change",
                           "Not enough pageview history yet.")))
```
